title: PerceptionPayload
description: L1 → L2 contract. Body of POST /perceive. One payload per content unit entering viewport (definition of 'unit' is site-specific, set by scraper.ts — see CLAUDE.md decision #15). Enum values must match shared/ENUMS.md verbatim.

session_id.description: Browser tab session UUID. Used to subscribe to SSE stream and to bind reasoning updates back to the originating tab. One tab = one session.

content_id.description: Stable ID for one content unit within the session — hash of content text + URL fragment recommended. A 'content unit' is defined by scraper.ts per site type: 1 tweet on Twitter, 1 post on IG, 1 article on news sites, 1 AI message on ChatGPT, etc. Used by L2 to dedupe and by L3 to bind reasoning back to the right DOM element.

url.description: Full URL of the page hosting the content.

captured_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the extension captured this perception.

text.description: Visible text of the post. Required even if empty (e.g., image-only post → empty string).

images.description: URLs of images in the post (in DOM order). Empty array if no images.

category.description: Output of Content Classifier Agent (L1). See shared/ENUMS.md → ContentCategory.

category_confidence.description: Classifier confidence in the category (0..1). Used by Coordinator to decide when to fall through to all-agent dispatch on low confidence.

synthetic_signals.description: Output of in-browser ML detectors. Optional — extension may omit fields if a detector hasn't loaded. Provenance Agent in L2 must handle missing fields gracefully.

ai_text_prob.description: Probability the text is AI-generated (perplexity-based or HF detector).

ai_image_prob.description: Highest AI-gen probability across images in the post (single number — Provenance Agent decides aggregation).

c2pa_present.description: Whether ANY image in the post carries C2PA Content Credentials metadata.

c2pa_verified.description: Whether the C2PA chain validates as human-captured (only meaningful if c2pa_present is true).

domain.description: eTLD+1 normalized hostname of the page (e.g., 'example.com' not 'www.example.com').

reputation.description: From hardcoded list in data/source_reputation/. See shared/ENUMS.md → SourceReputation.

user_state.description: Behavioral context. Optional. Per architecture.md, used as gating signal for annotation aggressiveness — NEVER primary detection.

scroll_velocity_px_per_sec.description: Rolling-average scroll speed when this content was captured.

dwell_ms.description: Milliseconds the content was visible in viewport before perception was triggered.
